verified_facts.text: The resort has easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola, Lionshead Village and Betty Ford Alpine Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here, you will experience the adventurous side of Vail, with easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola, Lionshead Village and Betty Ford Alpine Village.

verified_facts.text: Suites have whirlpool jet bathtubs and two balconies with mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxe suites boast whirlpool jet bathtubs and two balconies showcasing spectacular mountain views.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers an Apothecary experience where guests create custom-blended essential oils.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exclusive Apothecary experience to create custom-blended essential oils.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a four-season pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: 29,000 square feet of unparalleled event space and a four-season pool.

verified_facts.text: The accommodations are scented with spruce and fir aromatherapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fragrant with sweet spruce and fir aromatherapies, The Hythe’s elegant accommodations extend a sense of calm amid the snow-covered Rocky Mountains.

verified_facts.text: Rooms come with plush Frette robes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Plunge into luxurious beds and lounge in our plush Frette robes

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature a leather rocking chair.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in spacious Vail hotel rooms that feature a leather rocking chair and luxury amenities

verified_facts.text: The resort offers residences and penthouses for families and friends traveling together.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience alpine resort living in our Residences and Penthouses, as you serve dinner and drinks with flair, or relax with family and friends in a space that revolves around you.

verified_facts.text: The 4 Bedroom Penthouse Suite is on the top floor with a Vail Mountain view, balcony and fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vail Mountain view, Top floor, Balcony, Fireplace, Whirlpool

verified_facts.text: Most rooms have fireplaces and mountain views, and all have design details nodding to local history, including framed 10th Mountain Division pins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most rooms have fireplaces and mountain views, and all feature design details that nod to the area’s history, including framed 10th Mountain Division pins.

verified_facts.text: Margie's Haas is a tribute to Margie Haas, a World War II local home cook who welcomed 10th Mountain Division soldiers into her home.
verified_facts.excerpt: Margie’s Haas breakfast is a tribute to the World War II local home cook, Margie Haas, who welcomed soldiers from the 10th Mountain Division into her home.

verified_facts.text: The lobby bar serves Colorado-crafted whiskey and spirits in partnership with local distillery 10th Mountain Whiskey & Spirit Company.
verified_facts.excerpt: savor Colorado-crafted whiskey and spirits from our lobby bar in Vail, CO, in partnership with 10th Mountain Whiskey & Spirit Company, a local distillery.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary daily moments include fireside s'mores and tastings of locally distilled 10th Mountain Whiskey.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our complimentary daily epicurean moments, including fireside s’mores and tastings of locally distilled 10th Mountain Whiskey.

verified_facts.text: A complimentary all-levels yoga class is held on the Apres Deck in the summer months.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fresh air and flow with an all-levels yoga class on the Après Deck offered seasonally in the summer months.

verified_facts.text: The concierge team handles dining reservations, excursions and full itinerary creation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring full concierge services, our team of experts are ready to guide you during your stay at The Hythe, including dining reservations, unique excursions, and full itinerary creations.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a wintertime hike into the mountain for a treatment infused with native forest oils.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and mountain views.
